row.title: Unlearn now lives in ultrastable/unlearn
row.body: Rowan created the empty repo on 2026-11-25. A code session split instances/unlearn with its history, vendored promoqueue.js, stakeholders.json and models.json, and pushed it. The core keeps only the manifest; topology and system.json name source repo ultrastable/unlearn; seedlife reads build paths from build.repo; the system renderer writes a repo-root wrangler config for tenant workers. The tenant-repos workflow still has no org credential, so future tenant moves need the repo created first.
